title: 第11章  惊人的存活率
content_zh:
“你可真不要脸！”
“这是我和烬生哥哥忙活了一早上，才种植下来的几百株银龙草！”
“怎么转眼就成你种植的了？”
林月舒直接暴怒，心中气愤无比，直接厉声反驳。
毕竟，她早上可是受苦受累的，才种下这片银龙草，就这样被别人三言两语间窃走成果。
这让她如何能不气愤?
“廉妄言，好歹你也是三十岁的人了，能不能要点脸？”
苏烬生也没有想到这个廉妄言竟然如此无耻，当即不由得出声。
“刚才你说我们两个来了之后，便踩死了银龙草，而后你上山告知张长老！”
“直至刚才才下来，那么我问你，这一片银龙草是你何时种下的？”
闻言，廉妄言也是一时语塞，不知该如何反驳，但很快便眼珠子一转，出声道。
“清晨天不亮之时，我便前来种植，这些都是我下山接引你们的时候种下的！”
“如今你们空口白牙，一张嘴就说是你们种的了？”
“闭嘴！！”
张长老从震惊中回过神来之后，再度厉喝出声，同时，一脚踢在了廉妄言的身上！
“噗！”
廉妄言口吐鲜血，直接飞了出去，直至数丈之后，才重重的砸在了那片种植好的银龙草前。
剧烈的疼痛让他面部变得扭曲，但还是咬牙出声道。
“师傅，你打我干什么，这些银龙草真的是我种植的！”
下一刻，张长老的身影便已至身前，一把抓住廉妄言的身影，将其从地上提了起来，厉喝道。

“睁大你的狗眼看看，这银龙草的存活率，是你能够种植出来的吗？”
“你有几斤几两，难道我还不清楚吗？”
此言一出，廉妄言才猛然发现，这种植下去的几百株银龙草，除却第一株他种植外，竟然全部存活！
这，这怎么可能？
要知道，就算是师尊亲自种植，存活率也不过只有四成而已！
这两个杂役弟子种植的存活率，怎么可能有十成？
苏烬生闻言，也将目光落到那片银龙草上，心中闪过几分诧异。
显然没有想到，随手种下的银龙草竟然会有如此效果，着实让人意外。
虽然这些银龙草才刚刚移植不过一两个时辰的时间。
但是，却足以看出能否存活了。
若是不能存活，这些银龙草将会失去灵性，黯然失色，从而逐渐枯萎。
而眼下几百株的银龙草却是银光闪烁，一副生机勃勃的样子，完全没有半点枯萎的样子。
难道说，他体内的精纯灵气能够大大提升灵药的存活率？
可是，这其中有很多银龙草都是林月舒种植，难道她的灵气也是特殊的？
林月舒也是满脸的意外之色，先前只顾着一味地种植，未曾观察过生长之势。
如今望去，竟然全部存活！
这简直太不可思议了！
“师傅，可能是我今天运气好，所以才会全部种活的！”
廉妄言知道，到了这个时候了，一定不能松口，否则，今后师傅将不会再相信自己半句。
“这些真的是我所种植的啊！”

张长老闻言，心中怒火再也抑制不住，这就仿佛一个六七岁孩童告诉你，那万钧巨物是他抬起的一样。
孩童所言，尚不知天高地厚，还可原谅。
但廉妄言已经三十岁了，早已步入中年，却依旧信口开河，栽赃诬陷。
“咔嚓！”
只听一道骨头断裂的声音响起。
张长老踩在廉妄言的左腿上，面带怒意道。
“自今日起，你便不是我记名弟子！”
“待会便收拾东西，离开灵药峰吧！”
好歹他也是四品炼药师，在紫幕神山德高望重，拥有这样一个徒弟，简直败坏他的名声。
先前若不是看廉妄言种植的灵药存活率可达三成，又怎会将其留下？
廉妄言如遭雷击一般愣在了原地，显然没有想到，竟然因为今日的小事，而被逐出了师门。
先前依靠张长老弟子的名头，还能有几分地位。
若是被逐出师门，今后地位恐怕会一落千丈！
毕竟，宗门可不缺一品炼药师！
“不要啊师傅，我真的没有说谎，这些灵药真的是我种植的啊！”
廉妄言挣扎着身子，抱紧张长老的双腿，哭喊着出声道。
仿佛，真的受了莫大的冤屈一般。
不远处，苏烬生神色平静，并无半点怜悯之色，这种人，被逐出师门也好。
不然，只会坏了灵药峰的名声！
林月舒则是漠然的盯着那道狼狈身影，心中十分解气，暗道一声。

真是罪有应得！
“好！”
“既然你非得说是你种植的，那你现在就去给我种！”
张长老见其这般嘴硬，便直接厉喝出声。
“若是种植不出来，我便打断你另外一条腿！”
闻言，廉妄言顿时失声，因为他也知道自己有几斤几两，平常种植出的灵药能有三成存活就不错了。
全部移植存活，根本就是不可能的事情！
但是，他想要赌一赌，若是能够全部存活，自己不但能够继续待在灵药峰。
还能让苏烬峰两人得到相应的惩罚！
他就不信，这两个杂役弟子能够移植出全部存活的银龙草，而他就不能！
想到这里，眼中闪过一道精光，继而挣扎起身，一瘸一拐的朝着远处走去。
灵气运转，开始小心翼翼的移植起了银龙草！
苏烬生看着廉妄言那副模样，心中闪过几分戏谑之色，他倒要看看。
待会廉妄言如何收场！
张长老收回目光，脸上神色平静几分，看向苏烬生，询问道。
“苏烬生，这银龙草乃是你们两人一同种植的，还是？”
“回长老，这些灵药乃是我们两人一同种植的！”
苏烬生毕恭毕敬，如实回答出声。
“那，那你们两个能否再种植下几株，我看看你们是如何种植的！”
张长老有些激动，脸上满是期待之色的出声道。

要知道，移植灵药能否存活一事，要看运气，通常都是死多活少。
若是能够全部移植存活，日后至少能为紫幕神山减去一多半的开支。
这直接关乎到紫幕神山的底蕴！
而且，这还只是普通的灵药而已，若是珍贵的名药也能全部移植活。
那么日后紫幕神山的所有开支，灵药峰就能够全部承担。
这将让紫幕神山的底蕴，实力突飞猛进！
而他也能拿这些名药来炼制更加高级的丹药，不需要畏手畏脚，担心损耗的。
“可以！”
苏烬生点了点头后，与林月舒对视了一眼之后，便开始一同移植起了银龙草。
灵气包裹银龙草，手握根茎轻轻拔起，而后在另外一片空地刨个坑，种植进去。
张长老则在一旁仔细观看琢磨，眉头皱起，心中满是疑惑之色。
这种植的手法与他所传授的并无区别，甚至，比他还要粗糙几分。
怎么会有如此惊人的存活率呢？
真是奇怪！
content_en:
"You are so shameless!"
"These are the hundreds of Silver Dragon Grass plants that Brother Jinsheng and I have been busy working on all morning!"
"How come it was planted by you in such a blink of an eye?"
Lin Yueshu was immediately furious, and she was so angry that she retorted sharply.
After all, she had suffered a lot in the morning, so she planted this piece of silver dragon grass, and then someone else stole the results in just a few words.
How could she not be angry?
"Lian Wangyan, after all, you are thirty years old, can you please have some face?"
Su Jinsheng didn't expect that this honest lie could be so shameless, and he couldn't help but cry out immediately.
"Just now you said that after the two of us arrived, we trampled the Silver Dragon Grass to death, and then you went up the mountain to tell Elder Zhang!"
"I didn't come down until just now, so let me ask you, when did you plant this piece of Silver Dragon Grass?"
Hearing this, Lian Wanyan was speechless for a moment and didn't know how to refute, but he quickly rolled his eyes and spoke.
"I came to plant them early in the morning when it was dark. I planted these when I came down from the mountain to pick you up!"
"Now that you are talking so white and white, you are going to say it was planted by you?"
"Shut up!!"
After Elder Zhang recovered from the shock, he shouted loudly again, and at the same time, kicked Lian Wangyan!
"Poof!"
Lian Wangyan vomited blood and flew directly out. He didn't hit hard in front of the planted silver dragon grass until he was several feet away.
The severe pain caused his face to become distorted, but he still gritted his teeth and spoke.
"Master, why are you beating me? I really planted these Silver Dragon Grasses!"
The next moment, Elder Zhang's figure was in front of him, he grabbed Lian Huanyan's figure, lifted him up from the ground, and shouted fiercely.
"Keep your eyes open and take a look at the survival rate of this silver dragon grass. Are you able to grow it?"
"Don't I still know how many pounds you have?"
As soon as he said this, Lian Wangyan suddenly discovered that among the hundreds of Silver Dragon Grass plants that he had planted, all of them survived except for the first one he planted!
This, how is this possible?
You know, even if Master planted it himself, the survival rate would only be 40%!
How could the survival rate of these two handyman disciples’ planting be even 100%?
When Su Jinsheng heard this, he also cast his gaze on the piece of silver dragon grass, and felt a little surprised in his heart.
Obviously he didn't expect that the silver dragon grass planted casually would have such an effect, which was really surprising.
Although these silver dragon grasses have only been transplanted for an hour or two.
However, it is enough to see whether it can survive.
If they cannot survive, these silver dragon grasses will lose their spirituality, become eclipsed, and gradually wither.
But now the hundreds of Silver Dragon Grass plants are shining with silver light, looking full of vitality, not withered at all.
Could it be said that the pure spiritual energy in his body can greatly increase the survival rate of the elixir?
However, many of the Silver Dragon Grasses were planted by Lin Yueshu. Is her aura also special?
Lin Yueshu also had a look of surprise on her face. Previously she had only focused on planting and had never observed the growth trend.
Looking at it now, they are all alive!
This is incredible!
"Master, maybe I was lucky today, so I planted them all!"
Lian Wangyan knew that when the time came, he must not let go, otherwise, the master would never believe anything he said again.
"I really planted these!"
When Elder Zhang heard this, the anger in his heart could no longer be suppressed. It was like a six or seven-year-old child telling you that he was the one who lifted the giant thing.
What the children said is understandable and can be forgiven.
But Lian Huanyan is already thirty years old and has already entered middle age, but he still talks nonsense and frames false accusations.
"Crack!"
Only the sound of a broken bone was heard.
Elder Zhang stepped on Lian Wangyan's left leg and said angrily.
"From today on,You are not my registered disciple! "
“Pack up your things later and leave Spiritual Medicine Peak! "
After all, he was also a fourth-grade alchemist and highly respected in the Purple Curtain Mountain. Having such an apprentice would simply ruin his reputation.
If it weren't for Kan Lian's false claims that the survival rate of the elixir he planted could reach 30%, how could he keep it?
Lian Wangyan froze on the spot as if he had been struck by lightning. He obviously did not expect that he would be expelled from the school because of today's trivial matter.
Previously, relying on the reputation of Elder Zhang's disciple, he still had some status.
If he is expelled from the school, his status may plummet in the future!
After all, the sect has no shortage of first-grade alchemists!
"No, Master, I really didn't lie, I really planted these elixirs! "
Lian Huanyan struggled, hugged Elder Neng's legs, and cried out.
It was as if he had really suffered a great injustice.
Not far away, Su Jinsheng looked calm and showed no mercy. It would be better for such a person to be expelled from the school.
Otherwise, it will only ruin the reputation of Spiritual Medicine Peak!
Lin Yueshu stared at the embarrassed figure indifferently, feeling relieved and secretly saying.
You really deserve it!
"Okay! "
"Since you insist on saying that you planted it, then go and plant it for me now! "
Elder Zhang saw that he was so tough-talking, so he shouted loudly.
"If it can't be planted, I will break your other leg! "
Hearing this, Lian Wangyan suddenly lost his voice, because he also knew how much he weighed, and it would be good if 30% of the elixirs he usually cultivated could survive.
It is simply impossible for all transplants to survive!
However, he wanted to take a gamble. If they could all survive, not only would he be able to continue to stay at the Spiritual Medicine Peak.
It would also allow Su Jinfeng and the two of them to be punished accordingly!
He didn't believe that these two handyman disciples could transplant all the surviving Silver Dragon Grass, but he couldn't!
Thinking of this, a light flashed in his eyes, and then he struggled to get up and limped towards the distance.
With the spiritual energy circulating, I began to carefully transplant the Silver Dragon Grass!
Su Jinsheng looked at Lian Wangyan's appearance, and a bit of teasing flashed in his heart. He wanted to take a look.
How will Lian’s lies end?
Elder Zhang looked away, his face looked calmer, he looked at Su Jinsheng and asked.
"Su Jinsheng, did you two plant this silver dragon grass together, or did you? "
"Back to the elders, these elixirs were planted by the two of us! "
Su Jinsheng was respectful and answered truthfully.
"Then, can you two plant a few more plants, and let me see how you plant them! "
Elder Zhang was a little excited and said with a look of anticipation on his face.
You know, whether the transplanted elixir can survive depends on luck. Usually, more people die than live.
If all the transplants can survive, it will at least reduce the expenses of the Purple Curtain Mountain by more than half in the future.
This is directly related to the foundation of the Purple Curtain Mountain!
Moreover, this is just an ordinary elixir. If it is a precious and famous medicine, all of it can be transplanted.
Then the Spiritual Medicine Peak will be able to bear all the expenses of the Purple Curtain Mountain in the future.
This will make Zimu Shenshan’s foundation and strength grow by leaps and bounds!
And he can also use these famous medicines to refine more advanced elixirs, without having to be timid or worried about losses.
"Okay! "
After Su Jinsheng nodded, and Lin Yueshu looked at each other, they began to transplant the Silver Dragon Grass together.
Wrap the silver dragon grass in aura, hold the root in your hand and gently pull it up, then dig a hole in another open space and plant it.
Elder Zhang was watching and pondering carefully from the side, his brows furrowed and his heart full of doubts.
This planting method is no different from what he taught, and is even a bit rougher than him.
How could there be such an astonishing survival rate?
How strange!
